summary: This study looks at how a continuous glucose monitoring device, which tracks blood sugar levels through a small sensor, affects blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes who do not use insulin. Participants wear the device for two weeks, spending the first week with the screen hidden and the second week able to see their real-time readings. Kangbuk Samsung Hospital is sponsoring this trial with 120 participants to see if viewing the data alone changes blood sugar measurements. The study status is Active, not recruiting.
